integrity: The proof independently normalizes the three possible cover-facet types, derives every marked-chain upper barrier, and proves sufficiency by a longest-path potential construction. Minimizing chains give zero total slack and hence forced tangencies. Canonical lower and upper path potentials are both feasible, yielding the center-uniqueness criterion. Finite active-set replay is corroborative only.
scientific_limitations: The theorem is stated for bounded regular marked posets in the standard projected Euclidean realization. It does not assign facet clearances to redundant cover inequalities in nonregular presentations and does not determine minimum enclosing spheres or extremal ellipsoids. The complete center set is given by shifted cover inequalities; its face dimension is not separately classified for every marking.
title: Marked chains give the exact Euclidean inradius of regular marked order polytopes
